name: optimind
description: Local-first AI workspace for website growth

scripts.setup: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend && npm run ollama:setup && npm run db:create && npm run db:migrate
scripts.install:backend: python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e 'backend[dev]'
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && cd backend && .venv/bin/ruff check .
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
